description: Designs tailored onboarding programs for new employees and internal movers: pre-boarding checklists, a first-day agenda and first-week plan, a 30/60/90-day ramp with goals and success criteria, buddy selection and duties, adjustments by role type and location, and metrics for judging onboarding effectiveness. Use when someone asks for an onboarding plan, a new-hire checklist, a first-week schedule, a 30-60-90 plan, a buddy program, or wants to improve how people are brought on board.
